local_axes: X runs along the long courtyard elevation from its left return to the connecting roof. Y runs into the wing. Z is height above the garden-side threshold.
scale: The fourteen-to-fifteen metre width is a working estimate pending an independent orthophoto association. Camera baselines and dimensions are not surveyed.

design.kind: Restoration design perspective published by the service-wing architect. This records proposed colours and joinery.

album.kind: Sir Ellice Victor Elias Sassoon's personally photographed album. Digital scan is mounted with a black border. Native coordinates here refer to the registered full 1500-pixel IIIF derivative.
